name: Octree-based Sampling Optimization for PINNs
aliases: Octree-based hierarchical sampling optimization for PINNs
definition: An importance sampling strategy for training Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) that uses an octree to partition the spatio-temporal domain, allowing sequential sampling in indivisible subblocks corresponding to leaf nodes, thereby reducing the number of sample points required for convergence.
summary: An importance sampling strategy for PINNs that uses octree leaf nodes to model data importance, avoiding continuous gradient metrics and volumetric super-resolution methods.
